fact: Mauritania's population register agency ANRPTS launched the Hewiyeti app on 26 December 2023, letting citizens apply and pay for ID cards, passports and civil-status extracts online; the interior minister said it was developed by national engineers.
The Interior Ministry says the Houwiyeti application, which won the Africa T-Awards 2026 government category, was developed by a team of ANRPTS engineers.

Agence Ecofin reports that the Agence numerique de l'Etat, under the digital transformation ministry, developed the AI road-safety solution put into service across the national road network on 26 December 2025.
The AI road-safety solution developed by the Agence numerique de l'Etat went into service on 26 December 2025 and is operational across the national road network.
